today_trades.discrepancy_note: IMPORTANT: the exit routine's own PushNotification/summary claimed 'Realized P&L on that leg: Rs.1,092' -- that figure is WRONG for this trade specifically. Because window1 and window2 both traded the identical contract today (NIFTY 24050 CE, same strike/expiry -- spot barely moved between 09:18 and 10:33), Dhan bundles both fills into ONE cumulative intraday position line (Buy 260 @ avg Rs.42.92, Sell 260 @ avg Rs.47.12, P&L Rs.1,092 = window1's +1,235 minus window2's -143). The routine read that CUMULATIVE position P&L and reported it as if it were window2's own result. The Rs.-143.00 realized_pnl above is computed directly from window2's own entry/exit fills (45.30-46.40)*130, confirmed against the user's own Dhan order-history screenshot (10:33:48 BUY @ 46.40, 10:44:30 SELL @ 45.30, both 130/130 Success) -- that is the correct number for this trade. This is a systemic risk, not a one-off: any day where window1 and window2 land on the same strike will make the exit routines' own self-reported P&L wrong the same way. Not yet fixed in the routines themselves -- would need the exit routine to compute P&L from its own order's average prices (orderbook_agent_tool 'get' on its own entry/exit order ids) rather than from the position's aggregate 'Realized' field.
